narrative.overview: Midnight shelves, ink outlines, and a seal stamped on every book. The chrome stays calm and dark so the pages are the light source. Structure is drawn, not shaded: ink lines frame things, screentone dots give texture, and a hanko seal says whose library this is. The same world runs on the landing page and in the app; the app wears it more quietly.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight navy by default, paper (Washi) by day, OLED black for the dark, System to follow the device.
Ink outlines at three weights carry structure; there are no soft shadows.
Violet for what you touch; hanko red only as seal ink.
Metadata in a CJK-capable mono; CJK display faces only in big moments.
The logo is a seal that reads in three scripts.

rules.name: The Seal Ink Rule
rules.body: Hanko red marks identity, never action. If a red thing can be tapped, it is wrong (the Hanko accent option is the user's explicit exception).

rules.name: The One Violet Rule
rules.body: Each screen gives violet to one action. Everything else is ink.

rules.name: The Big Moments Rule
rules.body: CJK display faces appear only at 40px and up, in empty states, loading, splash and marketing. Never in lists, settings, controls or the reader.

rules.name: The Drawn Depth Rule
rules.body: No soft drop shadows anywhere. The only offset shadow in the system is the violet one under a primary action (5px 5px, no blur), like a seal pressed off-register.

dos: Do give each screen one violet action and keep hanko red for seals and marks.
Do keep metadata in M PLUS 1 Code and everything else in the platform face.
Do outline in ink and separate with space.
Do pair danger colour with an icon and a label, every time.
Do route new back buttons, sheets and switches through AppBackButton, showAppSheet and Switch.adaptive so they follow the platform; don't hard-code an iOS chevron or a bottom sheet.
Do respect reduced motion: every manga moment becomes an instant change.
donts: Don't add soft drop shadows or gradients to chrome.
Don't decorate the reader screen. The pages are the content.
Don't use CJK display faces for body text, lists or controls.
Don't recolour the seal, loop the logo animation in the app, or rest it on 읽 or 读.
Don't put real covers from the library on public pages.
Don't branch on Platform.isX in screens; read PlatformStyle so a forced interface style applies.
Don't animate high-frequency actions, or let wide screens stretch phone layouts edge to edge.
